articles.summary: Ares Acquisition Corporation II (NYSE: AACT) and Kodiak AI, Inc. announced the SEC has declared effective the Registration Statement on Form S-4 related to their proposed business combination. An Extraordinary General Meeting of AACT shareholders to approve the transaction is scheduled for September 23, 2025.
articles.title: Ares Acquisition Corporation II and Kodiak AI, Inc. Announce Effectiveness of Registration Statement and September 23, 2025 Extraordinary General Meeting to Approve Business Combination

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and Ares Acquisition Corp II secure $145M PIPE, bringing total investor commitments to $220M ahead of September 23, 2025 shareholder vote.
articles.title: Kodiak AI and Ares Acquisition Corporation II Announce $145 Million Investment to Support Proposed Business Combination

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and Werner show how autonomous trucks can operate inside existing TMS platforms—no new workflows, just seamless integration into real-world operations.
articles.title: Integrating Autonomy into the Heart of Trucking Operations

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and Roush announce the first Kodiak Driver-powered truck from Roush’s production line, delivered to Atlas Energy Solutions. With eight trucks already in service, the partners intend to scale to hundreds by 2026.
articles.title: Roush Delivers First Driverless Kodiak AI Driver-Equipped Autonomous Truck, Demonstrating Kodiak AI's Ability to Scale Deployment of Autonomous Trucks
